        TVC Communications is one of Nigeria’s leading broadcast companies operating market-leading channels including TVC, TVC News Channel, Max 102.3 Lagos, Adaba FM Ondo and TVC Digital. We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Business Development & Partnerships Lead 

Job Location: Lagos
Employment type: Full-Time

Qualifications
     

            
    




	Minimum of 6 years of experience, with at least 3 years in a media, broadcast or advertising environment.

We are recognized as one of Africa's most trusted entrepreneurially driven groups, distinguished by a strong governance culture, technology-led solutions, and an unwavering commitment to people.

We are recruiting to fill the position below: 

 Job Position: Bank Teller
     

            
    



Job Location: Egbeda, Alimosho - Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are looking for a reliable and experienced Teller to handle daily cash and customer transactions accurately and efficiently.
	The ideal candidate should have at least 2 years of relevant experience in a teller, cashier, or similar role.
	The candidate must be proficient in operating the designated business application(One App) and comfortable using it for daily transactions with minimal supervision.
	The candidate must also reside in Egbeda or a nearby location and be able to conveniently commute to the workplace daily.


Key Responsibilities


	Process customer transactions accurately and efficiently.
	Receive, count, and disburse cash while maintaining accurate records.
	Operate the designated business application confidently for daily transactions.
	Ensure all transactions are properly recorded and documented.
	Balance cash and transaction records at the end of each workday.
	Identify and report transaction errors or discrepancies promptly.
	Provide professional and courteous customer service.
	Maintain accurate daily records and reports.
	Follow company procedures and operational guidelines.
	Maintain confidentiality of customer and business information.
	Work effectively with other team members to ensure smooth daily operations.
	Perform other duties assigned by management.


Requirements


	Minimum of 2 years’ experience as a Teller, Cashier.
	Proficiency in operating the designated business application.
	Good numerical and cash-handling skills.
	Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
	Good communication and customer-service skills.
	Honest, reliable, and trustworthy.
	Ability to work with minimal supervision.
	Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
	Must reside in Egbeda or a nearby area.
	Must be able to commute conveniently to the workplace on a daily basis.


Method of Application

Sales Executive Job at GWX Limited




        
    

        
        GWX is a 2nd, 3rd & 4th party consumer-oriented supply chain management company with core competence in courier delivery service, haulage, logistics, air cargo services, service quality audit, third party verification, international businesses and customs clearing & handling.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Sales Executive 

Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	GWX Logistics Limited is seeking strategic and results-driven Sales Executives [Logistics Sales Representative] to build revenue generation, drive business growth, and oversee sales/commercial operations across the organization.
	Be responsible for driving sales performance, ensuring the achievement of targets across your allocated regions and business units through strong cross-functional collaboration.
	Seek/build strategic partnerships, new business opportunities, and implement effective relationship management processes to support sustainable growth.
	Work closely with the customer service and other stakeholders within the organization to enhance brand visibility and customer experience, while ensuring all leads are effectively managed through to conversion.


Basic Requirements:


	First University Degree [preferably in Sales, Marketing, Logistics, or related fields]
	At least 2–3 years of sales and marketing experience [1–2 years of experience in Logistics/Supply Chain … Industry]
	Strategic, analytical, and leadership skills
	Good or commendable track record of driving sales and business growth in a fast-paced environment.


Salary
N200,000 - N300,000 Monthly.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send CVs to: [email protected]m using the  Job Position as the subject of the email.
